card.name: Punctuation inside old scholarly citations
card.fires_on: Punctuation, spaces and small words inside bibliography entries for older scientific works, such as after the year, volume number or title. It is strongest in botanical and zoological references from the 1800s and 1900s.

modes.label: Volume and page separators
modes.description: The colon or space between a journal volume and the page number in a species citation.
modes.example: 589. 1896. Festuca texana Vasey, Bull. Torrey Bot. Club 13:<< >>119. 188

modes.label: Punctuation within reference titles
modes.description: A comma, period or colon inside the author, year or title part of a reference.
